selection_description: Ten widely documented mechanically expressible intraday strategy families selected prospectively for fair comparison; inclusion reflects benchmark relevance and does not imply profitability.

strategies.name: Failed-breakout reversal (long)
strategies.candidate_eligibility: regular_session; price 2 through 500 USD; completed 20-bar ATR positive; rolling 20-bar median volume positive
strategies.observation_window: 09:30 through 15:00 America/New_York using completed one-minute bars
strategies.exact_entry_trigger: A session low established at least 15 completed bars earlier is breached by at least 0.25 times ATR20; within the next three completed bars price closes back above that prior low; the next completed bar also closes above the prior low.
strategies.stop_rule: lowest low from breach through confirmation minus 0.05 times ATR20 at confirmation
strategies.target_rule: entry plus two times initial per-share risk
strategies.end_of_day_liquidation_rule: exit at 15:55 America/New_York completed-bar close less shared adverse costs
strategies.position_sizing_rule: floor 250 USD divided by initial per-share risk subject to shared exposure limits
strategies.missing_bar_treatment: elapsed-time windows require exact timestamps; missing required bars invalidate the candidate
strategies.halt_treatment: no entry while halted; open position exits at first executable post-halt bar under conservative ordering
strategies.corporate_action_treatment: only point-in-time split-adjusted bars with recorded adjustment provenance; otherwise exclude symbol-day
strategies.duplicate_signal_handling: retain earliest qualifying trigger per symbol while flat
strategies.daily_loss_behavior: stop opening positions after portfolio realized plus marked loss reaches 1 percent of initial equity
strategies.market_regime_eligibility: all preregistered regimes; report separately without filtering

strategies.name: First-pullback continuation (long)

strategies.observation_window: 09:30 through 11:30 America/New_York using completed one-minute bars
strategies.exact_entry_trigger: The first 30 session minutes contain an upswing of at least 3 percent whose terminal five-bar volume is at least two times the prior 20-bar median; the first subsequent two-to-ten-bar retracement is 20 through 50 percent of the upswing; a completed bar then closes above the preceding bar high.
strategies.stop_rule: retracement low minus 0.05 times ATR20 at confirmation
strategies.target_rule: entry plus two times initial per-share risk
strategies.end_of_day_liquidation_rule: exit at 15:55 America/New_York completed-bar close less shared adverse costs
strategies.position_sizing_rule: floor 250 USD divided by initial per-share risk subject to shared exposure limits

strategies.halt_treatment: no entry while halted; open position exits at first executable post-halt bar under conservative ordering
strategies.corporate_action_treatment: only point-in-time split-adjusted bars with recorded adjustment provenance; otherwise exclude symbol-day
strategies.duplicate_signal_handling: only the first qualifying pullback per symbol-day is eligible
strategies.cooldown: no re-entry after the first pullback resolves
strategies.daily_loss_behavior: stop opening positions after portfolio realized plus marked loss reaches 1 percent of initial equity
strategies.market_regime_eligibility: all preregistered regimes; report separately without filtering

strategies.observation_window: 04:00 through 11:00 America/New_York using completed one-minute bars
strategies.exact_entry_trigger: A completed regular-session bar closes above both the premarket high fixed at 09:30 and session VWAP while its trailing five-bar volume is at least 1.5 times the point-in-time baseline.
strategies.stop_rule: minimum low of the trigger and preceding four completed bars
strategies.target_rule: entry plus two times initial per-share risk

strategies.exact_entry_trigger: The completed bar has positive 15-minute return, exceeds synchronized SPY 15-minute return by at least 2 percentage points, volume is at least 1.5 times median volume20, and synchronized SPY closes at or above its session VWAP.

strategies.target_rule: entry plus two times initial per-share risk

strategies.observation_window: 09:50 through 15:00 America/New_York using completed one-minute bars
strategies.exact_entry_trigger: Wilder RSI14 is at most 25, close is below session VWAP, exact prior-20-bar return is at most minus 2 percent, synchronized SPY prior-20-bar return is greater than minus 1 percent, and a completed bar closes above the preceding bar high while RSI14 rises.
strategies.stop_rule: trigger bar low minus 0.25 times ATR20
strategies.target_rule: first of session VWAP or entry plus two times initial risk, provided the selected target is above entry; otherwise candidate invalid
strategies.end_of_day_liquidation_rule: exit at 15:55 America/New_York completed-bar close less shared adverse costs
strategies.position_sizing_rule: floor 250 USD divided by initial per-share risk subject to shared exposure limits
strategies.missing_bar_treatment: exact warmup symbol and SPY timestamps are required; missing bars invalidate the candidate

strategies.candidate_eligibility: regular session; 20 completed warmup bars; rolling median volume20 positive; price 2 through 500 USD
strategies.observation_window: 09:50 through 15:00 America/New_York using completed one-minute bars
